advisory_en: PREET VIHAR: flood probability 72% — risk level HIGH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 09:30 IST. About 154,941 residents are in the exposed area, with 18 hospital(s), 20 school(s) and 89.2 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, dense built-up. 1 pump(s) are mapped in this ward.

actions: Deploy the 1 mapped pump(s) to the lowest points of PREET VIHAR
